Xdelta 3
Source: https://github.com/jmacd/xdelta
Format: VCDIFF / RFC 3284

The worker is vendored locally so player ROM files remain in the browser.
The worker file was modified to transfer output buffers without an extra structured-clone copy.
See LICENSE-xdelta-wasm.txt in this directory.
